description.narrative: The All-African Movements Assembly ( AAMA) is set to be the biggest gathering of African and African diaspora activists, movements and civil society in recent times. It is a people’s platform to assess the original Africans Rising mandate and its implementation over the years and to renew our commitment to the mandate for the years to come. The Assembly affords African movements, both at homeand in the Diaspora, the opportunity to reconnect, ask deep questions about the African situation, take stockand re-strategise on ways forward. Objectives: The main objectives of the All-African Movements Assembly are as follows: 1. To render accountability for the mandate bestowed upon Africans Rising for the past five (5) years 2. To discuss vision and strategise on the movement’s commitment to the mandate for the next five to ten years 3. Create space for Africawide grassroot movement conversation on key concerning Africans Date and Venue The Assembly will be a 3-day conference from 29th to 31st August, 2022,to be held at MS TCDC Centre grounds in Arusha, Tanzania, where the Africans Rising movement began 5 years ago. Activities: 1. Pre-Assembly Activities 2. Regional Convenings in five (5) regions of Africa 3. Publicity, media soiree and web page development and design 4. Develop assembly programme and logistic support plan 5. Development of fundraising and donor mobilisation plan Main Assembly Activities: 1. Presentations on Africans Rising delivery on the mandate 2. Grassroot movements conversation key Africans issues 3. Focus group discussions on strategy for next 5-10 years 4. Artist performances 5. Virtual Conversations and Actions Post-Assembly Activities: 1. Finalisation of report on Assembly and sharing with members and partners 2. Finalisation of vision ( Kilimanjaro 2.0 and strategy document and sharing them with members and partners and publicising it on our public platforms

participating-org.narrative: Africans Rising is a Pan-African movement of people and organisations, working for peace, justice, and dignity. Africans Rising looks to play a critical role on the continent pushing governments, business, and even established global and national NGOs to focus onchallenges African’s deem critical, including demands for a fair global trading system, concrete action to address the effects of climate change and the creation and strengthening of a representative coalition to protect our natural resources and the environment. Africans Rising has a specific focus on issues including: • Expanding space for civic and political action • Fighting for women’s rights and freedoms across society • Focusing on the right to equity and dignity • Ensuring good democratic and corruption-free governance • Promoting climate and environmental justice
